question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The celebrity was __inundated__ with birthday wishes from his admirers.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Overwhelmed.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 inundated
 to bring to a place or person too much of something, so that it cannot be dealt with. (किसी स्थान या व्यक्ति को बहुत अधिक कुछ लाना, ताकि उससे निपटा न जा सके)
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
• 
 
​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Annoyed
 to make someone angry. (किसी को नाराज़ करना)
 
 

 Preoccupied
 thinking or worrying about something too much. (किसी चीज के बारे में बहुत अधिक सोचना या चिंता करना)
 
 

 Rewarded
 something given in exchange for good behaviour or good work, etc. (अच्छे व्यवहार या अच्छे काम आदि के बदले में दी जाने वाली कोई वस्तु)
 
 

 Overwhelmed
 to be too much to deal with. (निपटने के लिए बहुत अधिक होना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'Overwhelmed' is closest in meaning to the given word 'inundated.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4.
